data.title: Default limits on list commands, caps on title and note length
data.description: B8. The commands the CLAUDE.md section advertises have no default limit: at 4000 tasks task list is 4.6 MB, board --summary 1.25 MB, ready 407 KB. Claude Code truncates tool output at 25k tokens. Titles and notes have no length cap. Changes default output, so check against the --json contract. Evidence: docs/research/contract-stress-audit-2026-09.md §3
